sources.title_zh: OpenAI 以 1.25 万亿美元估值完成 110 亿美元融资
sources.summary:
OpenAI got its money, but not on the terms it wanted, and the gap between its growth story and investor appetite is landing on two giants. One faces a bookkeeping hit, the other a deeper dependency on the funding flow.

sources.recommend_reason_zh: OpenAI到账约110亿美元，仅为原定300亿美元目标的37%，对应1.25万亿美元估值，SoftBank与MGX参投，CFO Sarah Friar称Q3业务环比增70%、ChatGPT周活12亿。

en.reason: OpenAI closed about $11 billion—just 37% of its original $30 billion target—at a $1.25 trillion valuation, with SoftBank and MGX investing as CFO Sarah Friar cites 70% Q3 quarter-over-quarter growth and 1.2 billion weekly ChatGPT users.

en.title: Claude Code's "Don't Ask Again" leaked passwords in 1,122 public GitHub files
en.reason: Claude Code’s “Don't Ask Again” option let passwords and other sensitive information surface in 1,122 public GitHub files, highlighting credential-leak risks developers must watch for when using coding agents.

en.reason: Claude Code's Don't Ask Again feature exposed passwords in 1,122 public GitHub files; Boris says .claude/settings.local.json is meant to stay local and auto-gitignored, the files were manually committed, and recommends secret scanning.
